$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

notes.description: What the shield is for, and where its numbers come from.

absorption.description: Percentage of each damage type a blocked hit loses, 0–100; unlisted types pass through (0%). The rest of the hit (the unabsorbed remainder) still lands.

stability.description: Stamina a block saves, 0–100: the blocker loses the hit’s staminaDamage × (1 − stability/100).

raiseTicks.description: Sim ticks (60 Hz) the shield must be held up before it blocks (6 = 100 ms).

arcDegrees.description: Width of the frontal arc the shield covers, degrees, centred on the facing.

moveSpeedScale.description: Movement speed while the shield is up, as a fraction of the run speed (0–1).
